title: Choir and Hymn
author: Petra Blackwood
blurb: Isandro Marchetti, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
